mapper.select: SELECT employee_id FROM hr_attendance_record WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND attendance_month = CONCAT(#{monthStart}, '-01') AND clock_type = 4 AND is_delete = 0 GROUP BY employee_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{absentThreshold}

SELECT employee_id FROM hr_attendance_record WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND attendance_month = CONCAT(#{monthStart}, '-01') AND clock_type = 2 AND is_delete = 0 GROUP BY employee_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{lateFrequentThreshold}
